slides.title: SNS Cohort Control Tower
slides.notes: Pinned source; isolated tests and detailed limits in TESTS.md. No hosted demo or official score.

slides.title: 1 · Cohort export does not consult review decisions
slides.fix: Require accepted decisions bound to the findings digest for approved exports.
slides.notes: A synthetic exclude repair with an explicit reject decision was consumed by parse_repairs and removed the sample in _apply_file_repairs. The original source data were untouched; the problem is the derived export workflow ignoring the rejection.

slides.title: 2 · Flag for review can restore a missing record
slides.fix: Keep flagged absences absent until an explicit restore decision with supporting evidence is recorded.
slides.notes: A synthetic flag_for_review for a sample absent from B but present in A restored it and recorded action flag_for_review_restored, without an approval decision.

slides.title: 3 · No affecting finding bypasses movement and minimum-group checks
slides.fix: Evaluate analysis validity, minimum evidence and unexplained output movement before the unaffected Ready path.
slides.notes: Full load → diff → assess → build_document execution on four synthetic samples returned Ready even when the reference A1 difference changed from +2 to −8. The protein matrix was omitted by layout recognition, leaving zero affecting findings despite the rerun showing changed output. A 40-sample sign-change control returned Blocked, and an unchanged 40-sample control returned Ready. This extends the earlier helper probe into a full engine reproduction.

slides.title: 4 · Small wide matrices are silently unrecognized
slides.fix: Recognize layout from declared schema or robust headers independent of cohort size.
slides.notes: The full pipeline recognized only clinical.tsv for the four-sample fixture. It recognized both clinical and protein files for the 40-sample control. Consequently, the small-matrix omission can bypass the finding-dependent verdict path; it is not merely a display issue.

slides.title: 5 · Restoring baseline values is not independent correctness evidence
slides.fix: Label the result as baseline-recovery simulation and attach the evidence needed to approve each repair.
slides.notes: repair_restores_before compares the simulated repaired result with baseline output. That verifies recovery relative to the assumed trusted release, not whether the baseline record or proposed repair is factually correct. The README treats A as trusted; that assumption must remain visible at the repair decision. Acceptance: Demonstrate a documented correction in B: the tool should preserve uncertainty about A rather than recommend automatic reversal solely to recover the old number.

slides.title: 6 · A2 reproduction script stops before rebuilding
slides.fix: Serialize literals safely; execute both generated A1 and A2 scripts.
slides.notes: A2 generated script failed with NameError on true. A1 control exited successfully. Only invented data were used in the restricted sandbox.

slides.title: What is verified so far
slides.fix: Read TESTS.md for skips, positive controls and limits.
slides.notes: No submitted test suite identified in the inspected source; none claimed executed; independent safeguards are targeted probes, not a score.
